result:
I’d change the world by making empathy the default way we relate to each other.

If people truly felt the impact of their actions on others—across borders, cultures, and even future generations—many of the biggest problems we face would soften: war, inequality, exploitation, and environmental destruction. Empathy doesn’t solve everything by itself, but it’s the foundation almost every solution starts from.
